draft_method: Drafted with an AI tool from the video frames only (version 2): a 1 s contact sheet over the whole clip, at the granularity of docs/ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md section 1 (a new step when the hands release one item and reach for another, when the manipulation changes kind, or when a tool is picked up or put down).
